text:
maya (Product): Quick sync on Playground streaming UI. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz. Main decisions: streaming visual affordance, single action label semantics (Stop/Interrupt/Pause), token counter placement during stream, and whether prompt library remains interactive mid-stream. Thoughts?

arjun (Frontend): My two cents: avoid big DOM shifts. Use an overlay token pill anchored to right rail so messages can grow/shrink underneath. For streaming text, subtle gradient shimmer + append animation feels least jarring.

dina (Engineering): Shimmer + append is fine. On stop behavior: we currently cancel the SSE stream. Naming it "Pause" is misleading since we don't resume. "Interrupt" or "Stop generation" are clearer. "Interrupt" is shorter on buttons.

odette (A11y): Agree on label clarity. If we go with "Interrupt" make sure button has aria-label="Interrupt generation (will return partial response)" and that it shows a visually-hidden update when the stream ends. Also, live region for chunks should be aria-live="polite" with chunk coalescing so screen readers aren't spammed.

nate (PM): Users kept asking whether token counts would reflect partial responses after stopping. We should add microcopy on the token pill: "Counts may update after interrupt." Also we should avoid showing rates that block content.

arjun (Frontend): Implementation notes: token pill two modes — compact while streaming (tokens so far + small indeterminate ring) and expanded breakdown after completion. Keep compact height <= 36px to avoid overlap. Debounce counter updates to 150-250ms.

dina (Engineering): If we show an estimated progress ring, it must be purely cosmetic unless model gives a length hint. Otherwise indeterminate spinner is safer. Also when interrupt happens, the token count may change after post-processing; surface that in tooltip.

maya (Product): Prompt library UX: customers want to browse templates while a run is active but not apply mid-run. Proposal: library stays open but "Apply to prompt" button disabled with label "Applies to next run" and keyboard focus allowed.

odette (A11y): Good. Make sure disabled buttons are focusable with aria-disabled="true" and we provide an explanatory aria-describedby pointing to the "applies to next run" note so screen readers get context.

arjun (Frontend): I'll prototype pill + ring + tooltip + aria-live coalescing. Also make the interrupt button trigger an in-app toast: "Generation interrupted — partial response returned." Toast should be in live region but not steal focus.

dina (Engineering): Edge case: interrupt -> fallback to smaller model or aggregator might re-emit token counts; we should log that and show a tiny caret-down info on the pill that opens a changelog explaining discrepancy.

nate (PM): Action items: arjun prototype by Fri, odette to review a11y strings once prototype is up, dina to confirm cancel semantics with infra team, maya to update figma copy and microcopy. infra-bot: schedule staging deploy?

infra-bot: Deployment queued for branch playground/stream-ui -> staging at 2024-06-02 04:00 UTC

maya (Product): Thanks. Will reconvene after a11y review and the prototype looks good.
